description.narrative: FACT is a local NGO working to promote fishery governance in Cambodia. It hosts two main networks, Coalition of Cambodia Fishers (CCF) and NGO Coalition on Fisheries (NGO-CF) to advocate for better governance of fishery resources in Cambodia. FACT also facilitated Community Fisheries Network (CFN) which is a platform engaging multi-stakeholder representatives from government policy makers, NGOs and community fisheries to discuss and address issues and concerns encompass fisheries resource governance, especially its targetarea in Tonle Sap where it received fund from EU-Capfish project through consortium with Oxfam to implement inclusive green economyproject called FOSTER project. The Mekong climate change resilience project fits with the strategic goal number 2 of FACT focusing on improving livelihoods of Cambodian fishers which climate change and gender are mainstreamed and strategic goal 3 focusing on strengthening NGO and community fishery networks. Engaging in this project, FACT’s role in NGOs and community fishery network strengthening and especially its intervention in Tonle Sap is quite significant while Tonle Sap and the Mekong is inter-connected. FACT is expected to support CCF and NGO CF to join Network of Environment and Climate Change Adaption (NECA), coordinate with NECA to organize learning events on climate change resilience, climate smart agriculture model or climate hazards for CFF, NGO CF and other communities in the Tonle Sap, develop IEC materials for awareness raising to Cfis across Tonle Sap on water level changes and its impacts on Tonle Sap, and engage with MOE to influence climate change related policies. - Will focus on information sharing and support for networks and linking between networks such as the Coalition of Community Fishers (CCF), the NGO Coalition on Fisheries (NGO-CF), the Community Fisheries Network (CFN) and the Network of Environment and Climate Change Adaption (NECA). CCF has 55 and NGO-CF 38 member organisations. - Support coordination between networks and cross membership; support NECA to organise learning events on issues such as climate change resilience, climate smart agriculture models or climate hazards. - Develop Information, Education and Communication (IEC) materials targeting awareness raising among community fisheries groups throughout the Tonle Sap on climate change and its impacts in the Tonle Sap. - Engage with the Ministry of Environment to influence climate change policies . - Potentially link Project learning to their separately fundedlivelihood work in Tonle Sap communities - FACT is a current IP2 strategic partner and long term Oxfam partner including in the current EU funded project in the Tonle Sap.

participating-org.narrative: Fisheries Action Coalition Team (FACT) is a coalition of NGOs established in 2000 by a group of NGO members working on fisheries and environmental issues around the Tonle Sap Lake. It was established as part of the environment project of the NGO Forum onCambodia.At that time, a group of NGOs interested in fisheries issues formed a sub-working group which then was supported by different international NGOs such as Oxfam, NGO Forum on Cambodia, and Environment Justice-Foundation. The group of eight NGOs later decided to form the Fisheries Action Coalition Team. In January 2004, FACT separated forum the NGO Forum on Cambodia following the reform in fisheries sector of Cambodia, in which the government declared to release up to 56% of the commercial fishinglots to community management. FACT#s active members are all Cambodian NGO staff members who are committed to conducting advocacy in fisheries issues and monitoring policy reforms. FACT#s program mobilizes provincial NGOs and Community Based Organizations(CBOs) to more effective conduct advocacy programs that respond to development policies and development programs. FACT focuses its work around the Tonle Sap, Coastal and Mekong provinces, on issues that affect Cambodian communities# livelihoods. FACT collaborates with NGOs concerned with fisheries involved with local fishing communities. FACT works towards building a strong coalition of NGOs and local grassroots# organizations to protect fisheries, water resources and other natural resources in Tonle SapLake, Mekong River, and Cambodian marine regions along the coastal provinces.
